answer: Supervised learning uses labelled examples with known outputs, such as computer-aided diagnosis (classification with expert-diagnosed labels) and predicting age from biological variables like brain MRI [colliot_ml_2023_p013_paragraph_001]. Unsupervised learning works with unlabelled examples where the output is not known [colliot_ml_2023_p015_paragraph_001].

Types of learning
One usually considers three main types of learning: supervised learn-
ing, unsupervised learning and reinforcement learning (Box 2). In both
supervised and unsupervised learning, the experience E is actually the
inspection of a set of examples, which will we refer to as training examples
or training set.
